about: Shared golden cases for the query builders in clients/python, clients/go and clients/nodejs.
Each client builds every case below with its own API and must render exactly this CuteQL and
exactly these parameters. tests/CuteDB.Tests/ClientGoldenTests.cs parses every statement with
the real parser and runs it against the fixture, so 'codes' is what the engine returns, not
what someone expected it to return. Each client's live test does the same through the server.
codes are compared as a set unless 'ordered' is true. Dates use the {"$date": ...} tag, which
is how the server's JSON reader spells a datetime.

cases.name: select_all
cases.cuteql: SELECT * FROM qb_golden

cases.name: eq_string
cases.cuteql: SELECT * FROM qb_golden WHERE address.city = @p0

cases.name: ne_and_gt
cases.cuteql: SELECT * FROM qb_golden WHERE status != @p0 AND total > @p1

cases.name: ge_and_le
cases.cuteql: SELECT * FROM qb_golden WHERE total >= @p0 AND total <= @p1

cases.name: lt_or_ge
cases.cuteql: SELECT * FROM qb_golden WHERE total < @p0 OR total >= @p1

cases.name: or_inside_and
cases.cuteql: SELECT * FROM qb_golden WHERE address.city = @p0 AND (status = @p1 OR total < @p2)

cases.name: not

cases.name: not_or_and_present
cases.cuteql: SELECT * FROM qb_golden WHERE NOT (address.city = @p0 OR address.city = @p1) AND total IS NOT MISSING
